source: Minchat Shai + Kitzur on Exod 14:29 (the Ramah's wall-file; the Mekhilta and Yalkut; Rabbenu Bachya)
claim_en: ve-ha-mayim lahem CHOMA mi-yminam u-mi-smolam ('and the waters a WALL for them, on their right and their left'): the wall-word at 14:29 written LEAN — read as CHEMA, 'WRATH' (the Mekhilta: 'whence that even the sea filled with WRATH against them? Read not choma but chema'; the Kitzur: 'the wrath was over MICAH'S IDOL that crossed the sea with them — and this is: he passed through the sea, DISTRESS (Zech 10:11), whose finals spell רמה — the gematria of פסל מיכה,' 245 = 245, asserted; Bachya: 'a WALL for Israel, WRATH for Egypt — as Sennacherib's verse: a LIGHT for Israel, a FIRE for him'; MS adding his own seal in the walking-verse's tails, named) — and the census opens a GENUINE STREAM-VS-MASORAH SPLIT (checked): the Ramah rules 14:22's wall FULL ('the choma of va-yavou is written full, and all the Torah likewise except THREE lean: 14:29, Lev 25:30, Lev 25:31') — but THE STREAM writes 14:22 LEAN as well (four thin walls, not three): the wall-verse itself divides the witnesses — dual-tracked per the divergence law, the wrath-reading riding 14:29 on either track.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:27 (the anagram)
claim_en: va-yashav ha-yam lifnot boqer LE-ETANO ('and the sea returned at the turn of morning TO ITS STRENGTH'): the strength-word is Torah-UNIQUE here (checked) — and the Kitzur reads its letters whole: לאיתנו is the exact ANAGRAM of לתנאיו — 'TO ITS CONDITIONS: for the Holy One STIPULATED with the sea at the work of creation that it would SPLIT before Israel' (the anagram asserted at the build, letter for letter): the sea does not suffer an exception at the exodus — it keeps an appointment made at creation: the corpus files the chain's deepest legal reading of the miracle — nature's obedience as contract-performance, sealed in one rearranged word.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:20 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: ve-LO-QARAV ZE EL-ZE kol-ha-layla ('and the one came not near the other all the night'): the this-to-this adjacency stands ONCE in the Torah (checked) — and its Scripture-twin is the seraphim's antiphon: 'VE-QARA ZE EL-ZE — and one CALLED to the other: Holy, holy, holy' (Isa 6:3): the Kitzur — 'the ministering angels sought to say SONG; the Holy One said: MY HANDIWORK IS DROWNING IN THE SEA, AND YOU WOULD SING? — and this is: the one CAME NOT NEAR the other, those of whom it is said: one CALLED to the other': the night the camps could not meet is the night the angels could not harmonize — one frame for both silences; and in the same verse the light-word ויאר Torah-unique (checked): 'and it LIT the night' — the pillar's fire for Israel while the cloud darkened Egypt (Ps 118's God-who-lights named): the corpus files the tradition's most humane verse — heaven forbidding its own liturgy over drowning pursuers.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:31 (the two pairs; Pirqe deRabbi Eliezer)
claim_en: va-YAAMINU ba-YHWH U-VE-MOSHE avdo ('and they BELIEVED in the LORD and IN MOSES His servant'): the believed-word Torah-unique (asserted), its Scripture-twin 'and the men of NINEVEH believed in God' (Jonah 3:5) — the Kitzur carrying Pirqe deRabbi Eliezer's astonishment: 'NOT ONE of them remained (14:28) — none remained EXCEPT ONE: PHARAOH — and he went to Nineveh and became KING there; and this is why Nineveh's men believed: HE REMEMBERED WHAT HE HAD SEEN in Egypt and at the sea' (the drowned army's king resurfacing as repentance's own monarch); and the in-Moses word's census an all-Torah pair (checked): believing IN MOSES here — and 'the people spoke against God AND AGAINST MOSES' (Num 21:5, the serpents' verse): the Kitzur's law from the pair: 'who disputes his teacher disputes the Shekhina; who believes the sages believes the Shekhina' — faith and mutiny conjugated on one preposition.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 14:13 (the five) and 14:25 (the twelve)
claim_en: va-YOMER mitzrayim ANUSA ('and Egypt SAID [singular]: let me flee'): MS — counted in the Masorah 'among the TWELVE sevirin VA-YOMRU' (the presumption reads the plural; the text writes the nation as ONE MAN in flight — the written singular checked in-verse); and at 14:13 the chapter's second station: ki ASHER reitem et-mitzrayim — 'one of FIVE sevirin KA-ASHER where the reading stands ASHER' (the as-you-have-seen presumed, the that-you-have-seen written — the token checked at the build): TWO sevirin stations in one chapter — the corpus's presumed-but-not-written class (exo_02's presumed-she, exo_11's presumed-her) gains its flight-pair: Egypt fleeing in the singular and the seeing fenced without its kaf, both presumptions filed, both texts standing.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:8 (the Masorah's three)
claim_en: u-vene yisrael yotzim BE-YAD RAMA ('and the sons of Israel going out WITH A HIGH HAND'): the high-hand adjacency stands exactly THREE times, all in the Torah (checked): the exodus here, the itinerary's restatement (Num 33:3 — the same march re-dated), and 'the soul that acts WITH A HIGH HAND' (Num 15:30 — the defiant sinner, in the chapter of idolatry): the Kitzur — 'teaching that MICAH'S IDOL crossed with them, as they expounded: he passed through the sea, distress' — the triumphant hand and the defiant hand one phrase: the corpus files the chain's severest self-audit — the going-out's own formula lent to the sin marching inside the going-out.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:25 (the measure) and 14:21 (the Masorah's pairs)
claim_en: va-yenahagehu BI-KHVEDUT ('and drove them WITH HEAVINESS'): the heaviness-word Torah-UNIQUE (checked) — the Kitzur: 'because he said TIKHBAD ha-avoda — LET THE LABOR BE HEAVY (5:2's court, 5:9's decree)': the corpus's own measure-for-measure receipt — the heavy-word Pharaoh laid on Israel's shoulders returned into his chariots' axles (exo_05's decree-verse answered in-corpus, the kaved-ledger closed: the heavy heart, the heavy labor, the heavy driving); and the wind-word of the splitting Torah-unique too (checked): BE-RUACH qadim aza — 'by a STRONG EAST WIND' (its Psalm-twin named: 'by an east wind You BREAK THE SHIPS of Tarshish,' Ps 48:8 — the Kitzur: 'all the ships in the sea broke when it split'; and the corpus's own wire: 10:13's east wind BROUGHT the locusts — the same quarter-wind that filled Egypt with eaters now empties the sea for the eaten); with ויולך ('and He LED') Torah-unique beside it (checked — Elisha's blinded Arameans named: 'the Egyptians too were struck with blindness').

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:24 (the four and the pair); 14:5 (the pair)
claim_en: va-YASHQEF YHWH el-machane mitzrayim ('and the LORD LOOKED DOWN upon the camp of Egypt'): the look-down word's Torah-census exactly three (checked): upon SODOM (Gen 19:28 — 'as there they were judged in fire and brimstone, so here': the fire-pillar in the morning-watch), Abimelech's window (Gen 26:8), and the Egyptian camp — with Aravna's royal gaze completing the Kitzur's four outside (named); va-YAHOM — 'and He ROUTED them': Torah-unique (checked), its twin SISERA'S rout (Judg 4:15, named — the Kitzur's physics: 'the cloud-pillar wet the ground to clay and the fire-pillar boiled it, and their horses' hooves slid — as Kishon swept those, the sea spat these ashore'); and va-YEHAFOKH ('and [the heart] was TURNED,' 14:5) sharing its skeleton with SODOM OVERTHROWN (Gen 19:25), the locusts' reversed wind (10:19), and the curse turned blessing (Deut 23:6 — the census's four, checked; Isaiah's turned-enemy named): the chapter's judgment-grid runs on Sodom's own verbs — the corpus's second Sodom-wire in three chapters (the Lot pair at 12:31).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:14 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: YHWH yilachem lakhem ve-atem TACHARISHUN ('the LORD will fight for you, and you shall BE SILENT'): the be-silent word Torah-UNIQUE (checked), its Scripture-twin JOB'S 'who would grant that you WOULD BE SILENT — and it would be your WISDOM' (Job 13:5): the Kitzur — 'Moses said to them: silence itself would be wisdom for you, FOR YOU TRUST IN THE LORD — you need not cry out, only be silent': the five-word verse (the chapter's shortest — the battle-doctrine in one breath) filed with its wisdom-twin: the silence commanded at the sea is the silence Job's friends could not keep — one rare verb for holy quiet, at the water and in the whirlwind's antechamber.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:15 (the two-letter calendar) and 14:16 (the merits)
claim_en: MA-TITZAQ elai ('WHY do you cry to Me?'): the Kitzur's two-letter prayer-calendar — 'a hint: you are DESTINED to cry to Me MEM — FORTY days on the mountain, praying for Israel; and HE — FIVE words over your sister Miriam: EL NA REFA NA LAH (the five-word prayer checked verbatim at Num 12:13): A TIME TO SHORTEN AND A TIME TO LENGTHEN — but NOW is no time to pray at all: speak to the sons of Israel AND JOURNEY': the mem and he of Moses' why-cry spelling out his two future prayers (the longest and the shortest in the corpus's arc — both armed); and at the split-command (14:16) the merit-file: u-VQAEHU — 'and SPLIT it' — 'by the merit of VA-YEVAQA (he SPLIT the wood of the offering, Gen 22:3 — Abraham's verb Torah-unique, checked) the sea was split': the father who split wood at dawn buying the morning the water split.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 14:7 (the Hilleli vs the Masorah; the Zohar vs the Masorah; the Ramah) and 14:28 (the printed Masorah corrected)
claim_en: VE-SHALISHIM al-kulo ('and OFFICERS over all of it'): written ושלשם — the Masorah: 'UNIQUE, lean-of-lean' (checked: the only such skeleton in Scripture's Torah), the Ramah concurring letter by letter — while the HILLELI copy writes it once-full (dual-tracked: the great codex against the count); and on KULO MS's motto: the Zohar of the Song of Songs reads it with a final HE — 'but as I have declared MANY TIMES: WE HOLD LIKE THE MASORAH (qim lan ke-masoret)' — the stream's vav checked in-verse; and at 14:28 the chapter's third correction: the PRINTED Masorah's note garbled — MS restores the true three-verse grid of the not-one-left formulas (checked both in-corpus: Pharaoh's 'there remained not among them so much as one' 14:28, the swarms' 'there remained not one' 8:27; Sisera's middle form named): the officers thinned to their bones, the pronoun held to its vav, and the press corrected a ninth time.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 14:2 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: NIKHCHO tachanu al-ha-yam ('OPPOSITE IT you shall camp by the sea'): the opposite-word Torah-UNIQUE (checked), its Scripture-twin the visionary temple's traffic-law: 'he shall not return by the gate he entered — but OPPOSITE IT he shall go out' (Ezek 46:9): the Kitzur — 'as there, the gate one enters one does not exit — so here: Pharaoh and his host did not leave the sea by the way they entered it, but from the other side — as in Pesachim: Israel said, AS WE RISE ON THIS SIDE, THEY RISE ON THE OTHER; the Holy One said to the sea: SPIT THEM to the side Israel went out' (the drowned delivered to the survivors' own bank — 14:30's corpses-on-the-shore made geography): the camp pitched OPPOSITE is answered by an exit OPPOSITE — the pilgrimage-rule of the future temple pre-enacted as the sea's one-way door.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 14:1/5/6/8/10/11/12/18/21/24/25/28/30/31 (the letter-file; the Song-layout law); Kitzur (the remainder)
claim_en: The chapter's letter-file: LEMOR (14:1) — the lamed DAGESHED (checked); va-YUGAD (14:5) gimel hard; va-YESOR (14:6) — 'the alef at rest on sheva alone, NO lengthener in the yod, NO stroke in the samekh' (the harnessing-word triple-ruled); the revia ON THE NAME at 14:8; ve-HINE (14:10) unbound; HA-MIBLI (14:11) — the vowel-trial: R. Yona (on 'the YERUSHALMI codex he relied on' — Radak: perhaps THE BOOK BEN ASHER CORRECTED, that lay in Jerusalem, as the Rambam wrote) reads the he with patach alone, the precise books chataf-patach — dual-tracked, a codex-ghost in one vowel; the patach-resh MITZRAYIM beside our-dying (14:12); be-hikavdi's bet hard (14:18); LE-CHARAVA's pointing ruled (14:21); the morning-watch and morning-turn files (באשמרת "in the watch" unique, Saul's Jabesh-relief named; לפנות "at the turn" three in the Torah with Isaac's evening-field, checked at the build); U-FARO HIQRIV (14:10) — the pair with Pharaoh DREAMED (Gen 41:1, checked): 'though he dreamed and Joseph solved it, he remembered not the kindness — and drew near to fight'; the offered-offering derash and UZZA prince of Egypt named (15:2's my-strength armed); HAREM (14:16) unique with the shofar-cry and Elisha's floating axe named; VA-YOSHA (14:30) FULL-vav (checked) — the midrash reading it 'as if HE WERE SAVED: Israel redeemed, and as it were He redeemed with them'; the lengtheners of ve-YAAMINU ruled (14:31); HA-BAIM at the column's head — the he of the scribes' six-letter column-sign (בי״ה שמ״ו) named; and THE SONG-LAYOUT LAW ARMED (MS at 14:25): the brick-over-brick grid of the Song of the Sea per the Rambam, the Ramah, the Meiri, tractate Soferim and the book of Tagin — 'in ALL the printed books they did NOT write this song properly; I have set before you the true form, as I found it in the important ancient Sephardi scrolls' — R. Tam's brick-on-half-brick, the RIBaSH's nine-letter gaps, the Soferim's stringency down to Haman's sons: the next unit's opening law.
